prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 17 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: growth.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 52 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet.
